title: GS Fighter II
tagline: Fourteen featured fighters. The handheld edition, in the browser.
description: GS Fighter II, the Android 1.0.17 build, running in the browser: fourteen featured fighters with HD portraits and cinematic intros, V-wave orbs, momentum and short stops, the critical-health camera and survival recovery, Parallax Run with destructible boxes, the in-game music deck, plus the Sprite, Sound, Jump and V-wave workshops. Use GS MENU for runs, workshops and controller setup.
